name: goldenrod

purpose.why: Rebuilt on Evan's request (2026-10-22) to replace the Ranch tile's original model with a crafted one, keeping its game role.
purpose.audience: children building and playing in a miniature ranch
purpose.style: normal (upgrade: the same asset, built better)

brief.prompt: a clump of goldenrod, upright stems topped with plumes of yellow flowers

concept.tool: Midjourney web app (midjourney.com/imagine), driven in Evan's signed-in Chrome by Claude through the Claude in Chrome extension, one job at a time, text prompts only (no image reference)

hero.prompt: a clump of goldenrod, upright stems topped with plumes of yellow flowers, stylized 3D game asset, low-poly diorama style, flat painted colors, soft studio lighting, plain warm cream background, centered, full object visible, no text --ar 1:1
hero.pick_reason: upright clump with yellow plumes and margin above the tallest plume

construction.by: modeler agent, directed by the art director (Claude)

rounds.change: First build: 9 stems placed from the hero, 4 blobs per plume plus side sprigs, small core. 1,070 tris.
Plumes 1.7x wider with 5 blobs each, shorter blob apexes, bigger core and longer base leaves.
Dropped the side sprigs and a stem segment to get under 1k; more stem and base leaves, smaller core: base splayed too flat and the score fell.
Base leaves more upright (40-75 deg) around a column-shaped core.
Row-by-row silhouette check: shifted the foot left, widened it, moved the centre tip left.
Smaller foot shift, wider foot, plumes 1.9x, outer low plumes start lower.
The core read as a green boulder: made it small and covered it with bigger, wider upright leaves; plume blobs tilt randomly so stacks look ragged.
Front-back squash 0.82 to keep the plan close to the old footprint, thicker stems; seed sweep (+-0.01), seed 3 kept.
Final 768 px / 48 sample render and hero score; to_game.py goldenrod.

what_was_done: Scored on the hero alone (no turnaround). make_views.py keys the hero against its right-edge cream backdrop and drops the long tan cast shadow on the left (below the ground line: everything left of the plant's foot, and backdrop-darkened pixels without much hue change), then removes specks and fills small holes. hero_check.py scores views/hero.png from a matched camera: front-on (yaw 0), 6 deg up, harness lens.

9 slender Stem_Rust stems (3-sided, 2 segments) from feet inside a 6 cm circle to tips read off the hero, tallest in the centre (u 0.04, v 0.99 in hero units). Horizontal offset grows as s^1.5, so each stem rises near-upright and fans out towards the tip, which gives the outward arch.

The top 50-60 % of each stem is a plume of 5 stacked jagged blobs (6-point star ring between a short bottom and a long top apex, 12 triangles each), widest second from the bottom and tapering to a long pointed tip blob. The lower blobs tilt randomly up to 14 deg and sit slightly off the stem, so the stack reads ragged and fluffy rather than as a cone. Flower_Gold, with the tip blob and about a third of the others in Flower_GoldLight.

10 narrow lance cards (2 triangles, double-sided) up each stem below the plume, denser low, plus 50 bigger upright lance leaves splaying from the crown around a small lumpy Leaf_Dark core, so the base is densest and reads as leaves. Leaf_Green and Leaf_Dark, darker towards the base.

964 triangles (budget 1k), 5 meshes, one flat material each: Flower_Gold, Flower_GoldLight, Stem_Rust, Leaf_Green, Leaf_Dark (all match the regional loader's foliage words). Height 0.837 m as the old WW-347; ground footprint centred on the origin. No animation, no variants (plant group). to_game.py goldenrod ran cleanly and the game GLB is byte-identical to goldenrod.glb.
construction.creative_additions: The tip blob of every plume is in the light gold, as if sunlit, and leaf darkness grows towards the base for depth.

geometry.up: Z (Blender source); Y in GLB and game
geometry.origin: centre of the footprint, on the ground

good: Hero silhouette IoU 0.799 at 768 px from the matched camera: the flame-like clump of nine pointed plumes, tallest in the centre and the outer ones low and fanned out, over a dense leafy foot.
Reads as goldenrod at a glance: tall golden spires over a green base.
Under budget at 964 triangles (old model 13.2k), about 56 % of them on the plumes.
off: Width follows the hero (about 1.5x as tall as wide): 0.547 x 0.357 m against the old 0.387 x 0.334 m. The height is kept exactly (0.837 m) and the leafy foot is about 0.30 m across, but the fanned plumes make the overall plan about 40 % wider than the old GLB.
The plumes are faceted stacked blobs; at close range they read a little like stacked diamonds rather than the hero's soft feathery sprays, though at tile size they read as pointed golden spires.
The rust stems are mostly hidden inside the leaves and plumes; the hero shows more bare reddish stem in the middle third.
The IoU moves by about +-0.01 with the random seed alone; seed 3 kept.

rights: Original work for Abbie's World. Concept art generated on Evan's Midjourney account; geometry generated procedurally, no third-party meshes or textures.
